title: Form Builder Usability Issue - Privacy Notice
body:
### User stories

As a Form Builder, I am unsure what to do with the privacy notice, and what should be included.

### Acceptance criteria
- [x] Context around what to do with a privacy notice and why it’s required on the page is added as instructions
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Think this is done for the first release of the MVP.
